payload.last_assistant_message: --- ## Executive Summary The geo-tiered CTA mode toggle feature is fully implemented and meets all acceptance criteria in the spec. All syntax checks pass, and both `web-components` and `io/www` test suites complete with zero failures. One tech-debt item was found: the Studio override-dialog path in `mas-settings.js` does not propagate the `select` editor type for `ctaMode`, causing locale overrides to render as a text field instead of the sp-picker dropdown. --- ## Issues by Severity ### Tech Debt **Issue 1 — `valueEditorType` getter does not handle `'select'` in the override dialog branch** - **Location:** `studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js:386–389` - **Description:** When `this.dialog?.type === 'override'`, the getter explicitly handles `'quantity-select'` and `'addon'` editor types, then falls back to `'boolean'` or `'text'`. The newly added `'select'` type is never returned from the override branch, so editing a locale override for `ctaMode` renders a free-text `` instead of the `` dropdown. For the default settings dialog (non-override), line 391 correctly returns `this.settingDefinition.editor` = `'select'` and the picker renders as expected. - **Recommended fix:** Add `if (this.settingDefinition?.editor === 'select') return 'select';` inside the `if (this.dialog?.type === 'override')` branch (after line 388), mirroring the pattern used for `quantity-select`. --- ## Plan Compliance | Acceptance Criterion | Status | |---|---| | `ctaMode = 'buy-only'` removes `data-modal="twp"` links before mount | ✅ | | `ctaMode = 'trial-only'` removes `data-modal="d2p"` links before mount | ✅ | | Single conflicting CTA + `learnMoreUrl` → `Learn More` | ✅ | | Single conflicting CTA + no `learnMoreUrl` → `fields.ctas = ''` (no CTA rendered) | ✅ | | `ctaMode = 'default'` (or absent) → all CTAs unchanged | ✅ | | No content fragment data written; runtime-only mutation | ✅ | | `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` includes `ctaMode` and `learnMoreUrl` entries | ✅ | | `node --check` passes on all modified JS files | ✅ | | All new unit tests pass under `npm run test:ci` in both packages | ✅ | --- ## Verdict: PASS No blocker issues. One tech-debt item (sp-picker not shown in locale override dialog for `ctaMode`).
